title: Releasing a dragged technician header over a row opens no work order
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technicians {Technician-A}, {Technician-B} and {Technician-C} are active at {Location-A}; {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are pinned in your views, {Technician-C} is not.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST C682437 Ana, ZZAUTOTEST C682437 Ben and ZZAUTOTEST C682437 Cy.
  • Each of them leads one Approved work order: {Work-order-1} ({Technician-A}), {Work-order-2} ({Technician-B}) and {Work-order-3} ({Technician-C}).
    For example: customer ZZAUTOTEST C682437 Header Drag.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, every group expanded, "Search" empty.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Drag {Technician-B}'s group header up and let go over the row for {Work-order-1}.
  2. Look at the page.
  3. Drag {Technician-C}'s group header up and let go over the row for {Work-order-2}.
  4. Look at the page.
  5. Click the row for {Work-order-3}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the drag ends.
  • Step 2: no work order opens. Tech View is still shown, {Technician-B} is still among the pinned groups, and the pinned order is either changed by the drop or unchanged.
  • Step 3: the drag ends.
  • Step 4: no work order opens. {Technician-C} stays outside the pinned groups.
  • Step 5: the work order page for {Work-order-3} opens.

Known problem (SV-11402, Done; seen by Chris Ward on staging on 15 Oct 2026): the work order under the pointer opened when a pinned header was released over it. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new: the fix has not reached this site. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If no work order opens, mark it Passed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 66 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns), story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View); ticket SV-11402

  • S9-R9: “Allow pinned technicians to reorder only within the pinned area.”
  • S2-R8: “Clicking anywhere on a row, outside its own controls, opens the work order. A drag starts only after the pointer has moved a few pixels, so a click never turns into a drag.”

Not yet checked against a build.

AUTOMATION: READY
